ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central black region extending from the base towards the median notch. Distal lobes are primarily high-intensity white. Transition zone on the right lobe shows heavy black mottling and stippling. Single distinct vertical black line on the lower portion of the left white lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad U-shaped depression; approximate internal angle of 115 degrees; depth is moderate relative to total fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe tip exhibits significant jagged, high-amplitude variations in topography compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular white high-contrast spots scattered within the central black region. Large brown/orange biological clusters (barnacles) located at the extreme tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent white intersecting 'X' or cross-shaped linear mark on the left side of the central black region. Multiple thin, vertical black linear streaks on the white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive white cross-shaped scar on the left central region. Right lobe tip shows evidence of significant wear or trauma, resulting in a ragged edge and heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brown/tan biological growth (likely Coronula diadema) concentrated exclusively at the terminal points of both fluke lobes.
